description: Screen a customer, supplier or payee against official sanctions lists before onboarding, contracting or paying them. Fuzzy-matches a name (optional country, date of birth) against OFAC SDN + Consolidated, EU and UK lists (UN via EU/UK). Returns no_match, possible_match, confirmed_match or unable_to_determine with confidence, sources and coverage_limitations. Not legal advice. Use when one party must be cleared before money or goods move. $0.02 per call, USDC on Base (x402). Terms: https://sanctions-screen-production.up.railway.app/terms Privacy: https://sanctions-screen-production.up.railway.app/privacy

country.description: Optional ISO2 code or country name

dob.description: Optional date of birth YYYY, YYYY-MM or YYYY-MM-DD

name.description: Person or company name to screen

payment_signature.description: x402 v2 PAYMENT-SIGNATURE header value. Omit to receive payment requirements.

name: screen_sanctions
